aboutData.title: Who We Are
aboutData.subtitle: About BloodCare
aboutData.description: BloodCare is a digital platform dedicated to connecting blood donors with people who need blood support.
aboutData.content: Our goal is to make blood donation awareness, donor information and blood-related resources easier to access.

aboutData.title: Our Mission
aboutData.subtitle: Saving Lives Together
aboutData.description: Our mission is to encourage voluntary blood donation and create awareness about the importance of donating blood.
aboutData.content: We want to build a responsible community where healthy donors come forward and support patients during their time of need.
aboutData.highlight: Every donor can become someone's hope.

aboutData.title: Our Vision
aboutData.subtitle: A Better Tomorrow
aboutData.description: We imagine a future where people can find reliable blood support without unnecessary delay.
aboutData.content: Through technology, awareness and community participation, BloodCare aims to contribute towards a stronger blood donation ecosystem.
aboutData.highlight: A future where blood is available when needed.

aboutData.title: Blood Donation
aboutData.subtitle: A Precious Gift
aboutData.description: Blood donation is a simple act that can provide essential support to patients during medical emergencies and treatments.
aboutData.content: Eligible donors can donate blood through authorized blood banks and donation camps under proper medical supervision.
aboutData.highlight: Donate blood. Give someone another chance.

aboutData.title: Why Donate Blood?
aboutData.subtitle: Your Blood Matters
aboutData.description: Hospitals need blood for surgeries, accidents, treatments and many other medical situations.
aboutData.content: Regular voluntary donation helps maintain a dependable blood supply and supports healthcare services.
aboutData.highlight: Your small act can create a big impact.

aboutData.title: Blood Groups
aboutData.subtitle: Know Your Blood Type
aboutData.description: Blood is commonly classified into A, B, AB and O groups with positive or negative Rh factors.
aboutData.content: Knowing your blood group is useful during emergencies and helps healthcare professionals identify compatible blood for transfusion.

aboutData.title: Emergency Support
aboutData.subtitle: Help When It Matters
aboutData.description: During emergencies, timely access to suitable blood can be extremely important.
aboutData.content: BloodCare promotes donor awareness and encourages people to stay connected with the blood donation community.
aboutData.highlight: Be ready to help when someone needs you.

aboutData.title: Donor Registration
aboutData.subtitle: Become A Donor
aboutData.description: Eligible people can register themselves as donors and become part of a community committed to helping others.
aboutData.content: A strong donor network can help spread awareness and encourage voluntary blood donation.

aboutData.title: Blood Banks
aboutData.subtitle: Safe Blood Management
aboutData.description: Blood banks are essential for collecting, testing, storing and supplying blood for medical requirements.
aboutData.content: BloodCare encourages people to use authorized blood banks and follow proper healthcare guidance.

aboutData.title: Community Awareness
aboutData.subtitle: Spread The Message
aboutData.description: Awareness can help remove misconceptions and encourage more people to become voluntary blood donors.
aboutData.content: Students, organizations and communities can participate in awareness campaigns and donation activities.
aboutData.highlight: One message can inspire many donors.

aboutData.title: Safety & Responsibility
aboutData.subtitle: Donate Responsibly
aboutData.description: Blood donation should always take place through authorized healthcare professionals and proper medical procedures.
aboutData.content: Donors should provide accurate health information and follow instructions given by qualified medical staff.

aboutData.title: Join BloodCare
aboutData.subtitle: Be Someone's Hope
aboutData.description: You can support the cause by donating blood, spreading awareness or encouraging your friends and family to participate.
aboutData.content: Together, communities can create a stronger network of voluntary donors and promote the importance of blood donation.
aboutData.highlight: Together we can make a difference.
